title: Display charger unique IDs on Map Monitor using “View Charger Ids” icon
summary: Use the Map Monitor Quick Select panel to display unique charger IDs on the map so you can identify chargers by ID.
when_to_use: When you need to identify chargers by their unique IDs on the Map Monitor map display.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Map Monitor Quick Select steps to display charger IDs and verify they appear on the map.
access_or_tools_needed: Quick Select panel icon “View Charger Ids”

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel showing the “View Charger Ids” icon and related Quick Select icons.

steps.title: Open the Map Monitor screen that contains the Quick Select icons
steps.purpose: Access the Quick Select panel where the “View Charger Ids” icon is located.
steps.instruction: Open the Map Monitor screen that contains the Quick Select icons.
steps.expected_result: The Quick Select panel with icons is visible on the Map Monitor screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The Quick Select panel is present and includes the icon labeled “View Charger Ids”.
steps.failure_condition: The Quick Select panel (or the “View Charger Ids” icon) is not visible.

actions.label: Verify Quick Select panel is visible
actions.exact_action: Open the Map Monitor screen that contains the Quick Select icons.

steps.title: Click the “View Charger Ids” icon in the Quick Select panel
steps.purpose: Trigger the map display of charger objects with their unique IDs.
steps.instruction: In the Quick Select panel, click the “View Charger Ids” icon.
steps.expected_result: Charger objects on the map display unique charger IDs after clicking “View Charger Ids.”
steps.healthy_condition: Charger IDs appear on charger objects on the map.
steps.failure_condition: Charger IDs do not appear on the map after clicking “View Charger Ids”.

actions.label: Select View Charger Ids
actions.exact_action: Click the “View Charger Ids” icon in the Quick Select panel.

steps.title: Verify charger objects display unique charger IDs on the map
steps.purpose: Confirm the map overlay correctly shows unique IDs for chargers.
steps.instruction: On the map, verify that charger objects display unique charger IDs.
steps.expected_result: All chargers in the system show unique charger IDs on the map after clicking “View Charger Ids.”
steps.healthy_condition: If there are multiple chargers, multiple unique IDs are shown (example given: 10 chargers => 10 unique IDs).
steps.failure_condition: Charger IDs are not visible on charger objects.

actions.label: Check charger ID labels on map
actions.exact_action: On the map, verify that charger objects display unique charger IDs.

stop_or_escalate_if: If charger IDs are not visible, stop and escalate (no remediation steps are provided in the source).

success_criteria: After clicking “View Charger Ids”, charger objects on the Map Monitor map display unique charger IDs.
healthy_conditions: Charger IDs are visible on charger objects on the map.
When multiple chargers exist, multiple unique IDs are shown (example: 10 chargers => 10 unique IDs).
failure_conditions: Charger IDs do not appear on the map after clicking “View Charger Ids”.
escalation_guidance: If charger IDs are not visible, stop and escalate because the source provides no troubleshooting/remediation steps.
